meaning: The occurrence of happy or beneficial events by chance
example: Finding that old friend at the café was pure serendipity.

meaning: Lasting for a very short time
example: The ephemeral beauty of cherry blossoms makes them more precious.

meaning: The ability to recover quickly from difficulties
example: Her resilience after the loss inspired everyone around her.

meaning: Open to more than one interpretation; not clear
example: The contract had several ambiguous clauses that caused confusion.

meaning: Fluent and persuasive in speaking or writing
example: She gave an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience.

meaning: A deep, persistent feeling of sadness or depression
example: A sense of melancholy settled over him as autumn arrived.

meaning: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically
example: We need a pragmatic approach to solve this problem quickly.

meaning: Truthful and straightforward; frank
example: I appreciate your candid feedback on my work.

meaning: Holding firmly to a purpose; persistent and determined
example: His tenacious pursuit of the goal finally paid off.

meaning: So delicate or precise as to be difficult to notice
example: There was a subtle difference in tone between the two paintings.

meaning: The ability to understand something instinctively, without reasoning
example: Her intuition told her something was wrong before anyone spoke.

meaning: Having deep meaning or great insight
example: Reading that book had a profound effect on how I see the world.

meaning: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
example: She was meticulous in reviewing every line of the report.

meaning: No longer in use; out of date
example: That technology became obsolete within just a few years.

meaning: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another
example: Good leaders show empathy toward their team members.

meaning: Having mixed feelings or contradictory ideas about something
example: She felt ambivalent about leaving her hometown for the new job.

meaning: To examine or inspect closely and thoroughly
example: The committee will scrutinize every detail of the proposal.

meaning: Expressed clearly; easy to understand
example: His lucid explanation made a complex topic easy to grasp.

meaning: A sentimental longing for the past
example: The old song filled her with nostalgia for her school days.

meaning: Continued effort to achieve something despite difficulty
example: His perseverance through years of failure eventually led to success.

meaning: Using more words than needed; long-winded
example: His verbose report could have been summarized in one page.

meaning: Showing selfless concern for the wellbeing of others
example: Her altruistic nature led her to donate most of her salary to charity.

meaning: Believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest
example: He became cynical about politics after years of broken promises.

meaning: Having or showing care in one's work or duties
example: She was diligent in her studies and rarely missed a class.

meaning: Difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious
example: The enigmatic smile on the statue puzzled researchers for decades.

meaning: Sparing or economical with money or resources
example: Living a frugal lifestyle helped him save enough to retire early.

meaning: Fond of company; sociable
example: She was so gregarious that she made friends everywhere she went.

meaning: Lacking any obvious principle of organization
example: The files were arranged in a haphazard manner with no clear system.

meaning: Treating all rivals or disputants equally; unbiased
example: A judge must remain impartial throughout the entire trial.

meaning: Cheerful and friendly; good-humored
example: His jovial personality made every team meeting enjoyable.

meaning: Affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathetic

meaning: Lacking interest or excitement; dull and ordinary
example: Even mundane tasks like washing dishes can be meditative.

meaning: Feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed
example: He answered the tough question in a nonchalant tone that surprised everyone.

meaning: Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action
example: He was too obstinate to admit he had made a mistake.

meaning: Engaged in deep or serious thought
example: She sat by the window in a pensive mood, staring at the rain.

meaning: Attractively unusual or old-fashioned
example: They stayed in a quaint little inn at the edge of the village.

meaning: Not or no longer needed; superfluous
example: Several steps in the process were redundant and wasted time.

meaning: Enduring pain or hardship without showing feelings or complaining
example: She remained stoic throughout the difficult negotiation.

meaning: Lasting only for a short time; impermanent
example: Fame can be transient — here today and forgotten tomorrow.

meaning: Playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing way
example: The children loved the whimsical illustrations in the storybook.
